rows.title: Germinal Commodity details lists its errors by question, and leaves temperature and total gross weight optional
rows.detail: On the germinal products set's Commodity details page, the error summary groups errors by question rather than by species: every Total gross weight error, species by species, then every Number of packages error. Temperature and total gross weight are optional for germinal products, so neither raises an error when left blank. This lets a trader fix one question across every species at once.
acceptanceCriteria: Pressing Save and continue on germinal Commodity details with errors on several species lists every Total gross weight error, species by species, before every Number of packages error, each linking to its own field. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-021, -p1-057)

Germinal Commodity details with no temperature chosen, a blank total gross weight and a valid number of packages for every chosen species saves and moves the trader on, with no error summary on the page. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-021, -p1-023; c-232)

The germinal Commodity details error summary lists only Total gross weight and Number of packages messages, however the temperature question is answered. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-021, -p1-023; c-232)
rows.notes: The commodities area's half of the existing germinal Commodity details checks row: the error summary ordered by question, and an unanswered temperature and blank total gross weight saving. The germinal-products area drafts the weight and packages rules on the same page; the combiner keeps them in one row, as now, since they share one page and one set of checks. Depends on the germinal Commodity details questions row (inc-017), which adds the weight and packages fields. c-232 (ruled) makes the germinal total gross weight and temperature optional, so no blank-weight or blank-temperature message is built. The live-animals half of the error-ordering rule (req-114) belongs to the split-off design-snagging theme and is not drafted here.
